overloadMerges.note: The doc syntax line has no parenthesized parameter list ('Storage : Object'), so the mechanical parser produced an empty overload with no return type at all; restored the documented Object return type.
overloadMerges.semanticRole: Returns the catalog of shared objects and shared collections registered in the Storage object of the current machine or component.

constraints: There is one Storage catalog per machine and per component; the returned object is itself a shared object and can only contain shared objects and shared collections.
Adding a property to the returned object must be surrounded by Use...End use; reading an attribute outside of Use...End use is possible, but writing without it raises an error.
